leastWorthwhile.text: Making the initial cut was straightforward setup; it was less interesting than seeing how the leak was stopped.

surprise.text: The bleeding stopped even though the skin above the vessel was still open. I had not thought about those as separate stages.

arbitrary.text: None felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and enzyme label made the pairings clear, although they did not explain in detail how the enzymes make threads.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the open skin heals after the bleeding stops, since this chapter left that part unfinished.
